name: Card stack
what: A loose pile of cards shuffles - the top card slides out and goes under, again and again - then one card comes forward, straightens and lights up with a glowing edge while the rest dim. Payments, membership, picks, a reveal.

learned_from.what: green glowing cards shuffling, one coming forward and glowing

motion: drops 12 f, 2 f apart; a shuffle every 14 f (out 8 f, back 10 f); the pick forward 16 f (S-curve), the glow 12 f; the rest dim
